text:
ana: onboarding hit a weird failure when installing the python sample-app in CI. poetry lock -> exported reqs, pip install -r requirements.txt fails with ImportError: cannot import name 'TypedDict' from 'typing_extensions'. Locally works with `poetry install`.
mike: is the exported file pinning typing-extensions?
nana: yes, reqs has `typing-extensions==4.6.3`. CI log shows pip tries for 4.6.3 but then installs 4.5.0 from our internal index.
ci-bot: job #12111 failed at "pip install -r requirements.txt"  https://ci.internal/12111/logs
ana: exact snippet: ```Collecting typing-extensions==4.6.3
  Downloading typing_extensions-4.5.0-py3-none-any.whl (28 kB)
Successfully installed typing-extensions-4.5.0``` so the filename served by the index is wrong.
mike: that explains the TypedDict missing. Two quick options: 1) in CI pre-install the exact wheel from PyPI with `python -m pip install --no-cache-dir typing-extensions==4.6.3 -i https://pypi.org/simple`, or 2) force sdist rebuild: `pip install --no-binary typing-extensions -r requirements.txt`.
sasha: FYI we've seen similar issues where wheels in the mirror had wrong metadata. Infra: can you check mirror health?
infra: opened ticket INFRA-1117, purging suspect entries for typing-extensions and triggering re-sync.
nana: tried `--no-binary` but sdist build in CI failed due to missing build deps on the runner. I added a step to upgrade build tools: `python -m pip install --upgrade pip build setuptools wheel` before installing. That let sdist build succeed.
mike: good workaround. Long-term we should: 1) add a sanity check in sample-app CI that asserts `python -c "import typing_extensions as te; print(te.__version__)"` after install, 2) add packaging smoke tests in sdk-python release pipeline that build and install wheel into fresh venv and import typing-only modules.
sasha: also adding a short doc blurb in devex: "poetry export -> pip CI tips" with recommended precommands and trap notes.
ci-bot: re-run #12111 after infra purge passed on branch: https://ci.internal/12112 :tada:
nana: closing this thread once infra confirms purge is permanent. added PR to sample-app with the pre-upgrade step and the post-install version assertion: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/210
mike: filed sdk-python issue to add packaging test and update pyproject to include `py.typed` and any .pyi stubs: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/380
ana: thanks everyone, temporary CI fix in place. will follow up in INFRA-1117. :white_check_mark:
